Resample a 3D dicom_volume or dicom_seg to Target Voxel Spacing

Source: R/dl-prep.R
volume_resample.Rd

Resamples a 3D dicom_volume or dicom_seg object to target_spacing (in millimeters) using high-speed C++17 trilinear interpolation (for continuous imaging intensities) or nearest-neighbor interpolation (for discrete segmentation masks and label-maps), updating the 4x4 spatial affine matrix and spacing metadata while preserving the physical origin.

Usage

volume_resample(
  vol,
  target_spacing = c(1, 1, 1),
  method = c("trilinear", "nearest")
)

Arguments

vol

A dicom_volume or dicom_seg object.

target_spacing

Numeric vector of length 3 giving target spacing c(dr, dc, dz) in millimeters. Default is c(1, 1, 1).

method

Interpolation method: "trilinear" (default for images) or "nearest" (default automatically when vol is a dicom_seg if not explicitly overridden).

Value

A resampled dicom_volume (or dicom_seg) object with updated voxels, affine, and spacing.

Examples

synth <- dicom_synthesize(modality = "CT", dims = c(16L, 16L, 4L))
vol <- read_dicom_volume(synth[["out_dir"]])
vol_iso <- volume_resample(vol, target_spacing = c(1, 1, 1))
dim(vol_iso)
#> [1] 16 16 10
unlink(synth[["out_dir"]], recursive = TRUE)
